purpose: Backward-compatible scoped hotel enrichment. Public canonical fields remain authoritative unless explicitly promoted after review.

contract.contacts: Array of scoped operator/booking/directory contacts; never overwrite canonical phone automatically.
contract.capacity: Array of source-scoped inventory evidence; never overwrite room_count automatically.
contract.star_claims: Non-official claims stay separate from official classification.
contract.operations: Source-scoped operational facts such as check-in/out/front-desk. Do not infer when absent.
contract.gps: This file never promotes GPS and must not be used to bypass hotel GPS HOLD/quarantine.
contract.amenity_claims: Source-scoped amenity/service claims; not a promise of current availability. Preserve source and checked_at.
